content.title: About
content.content: Cereal, O's, honey nut are dry whole‑grain wheat flakes enriched with honey and a nutty flavor. The flakes are light and crunchy with a sweet taste highlighted by honey and nut notes. The product is intended for a quick breakfast, usually poured with milk or a plant‑based beverage.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The original O's were launched in the 1970s as part of a major breakfast cereal line.
The honey nut variant appeared in the 1990s when demand for sweeter, aromatic cereals grew.
Flakes are coated with a thin layer of honey, giving them a characteristic golden colour.
Whole grains are retained, preserving a high amount of dietary fibre.
Packaging often features bright yellow and brown colours to emphasize honey and nuts.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Whole‑grain flakes provide sustained energy through slowly digestible carbs.

items.title: Rich in fibre
items.content: Fibre supports normal digestive function and promotes satiety.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2 and B6 are involved in carbohydrate metabolism and nervous‑system health.

items.title: Honey content
items.content: Honey adds natural antioxidants and small amounts of minerals such as potassium and magnesium.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Unlike many sweet breakfast cereals, these flakes contain minimal fat when served with plain milk.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Honey adds sugar, increasing the calorie count; people monitoring blood glucose should watch portion size.

items.title: Nut allergy risk
items.content: Although the nut flavor is artificial, some batches may contain trace nuts.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Wheat‑based flakes contain gluten and are unsuitable for those with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour milk, kefir or a plant‑based drink over the flakes, wait 2‑3 minutes, then stir. They can also be added to yogurt, smoothies, used as a base for dessert parfaits, or topped with fresh fruit.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, reseal tightly to prevent moisture absorption, which can make the flakes lose their crunch.
